projects.summary: A one-page portfolio for a software engineer, led by a single path from hello to contact.
projects.description:
A light, spacious portfolio homepage for a software engineer. A dotted line runs through the whole page and guides the eye from the introduction to services, education, experience and contact.

Oversized section words sit quietly in the background, while soft cards and one solid black card keep attention on the main message.

background.alt: Portfolio homepage design with a waving character and the heading Hi, I am Rahim, your new Software Engineer
